oe_wnd_hagia_sophia_dome = {
    audio_tier = 5
    is_special = yes
    is_foreign = no
    in_empty = owned
    pop_type = clergy
    max_levels = 1
    employment_size = 1.0
    category = religious_category

    rural_settlement = no
    town = yes
    city = yes
    megalopolis = yes

    expensive = yes
    forbidden_for_estates = yes
    can_destroy = { always = no }

    build_time = 1095
    construction_demand = library_construction

    location_potential = {
        this = location:constantinople
    }
    country_potential = {
        owns = location:constantinople
    }
    allow = {
        owner ?= {
            OR = {
                religion.group = religion_group:christian
                modifier:tolerance_heathen >= 0
            }
        }
    }

    on_built = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wnd_w1_done }
                location = { has_owner = yes }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_w1_done value = 1 }
            location.owner = {
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wnd.1
            }
        }
    }

    unique_production_methods = {
        oe_wnd_hagia_sophia_dome_maint = {
            icon_type = building_type
            icon = oe_wnd_hagia_sophia_dome
            masonry = 0.4
            marble = 0.3
            goods_gold = 0.15
            incense = 0.25
            category = building_maintenance
        }
    }

    modifier = {
        local_monthly_prosperity = 0.003
        local_clergy_max_literacy = 10
        local_cultural_tradition = 0.2
    }
}
